focus_areas: Integrity of the foreground metal grid intersections (no melting/fusion).
Consistency of perspective lines in the background building.
Verification that the background structure contains prison-specific features (e.g., barred windows) rather than generic residential features.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the foreground grid. AI often fails at rendering consistent, straight parallel lines in grids, especially where they overlap or go out of focus. Check if the bars maintain consistent thickness and if the intersections look physically welded or fused incorrectly. Also, verify if the background blur looks like optical bokeh or AI smearing.
image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot looking through a dark, heavy metal grid or cage in the foreground. The background is out of focus (bokeh), revealing a multi-story building facade with light-colored walls and blue window frames or railings. The perspective suggests an interior view looking out into a courtyard or adjacent wing of a secure facility.

expert_testimonies.reason: To verify the spatial relationship between the foreground cage and the background building is physically consistent and not warped.
To confirm the scene is indeed a correctional facility and not just a generic industrial building or apartment complex.
